basavanna.name: Basavanna
basavanna.subtitle: 12th-century social reformer, philosopher, and statesman. Founder of the Lingayat movement and master of the vachana tradition.

meanings.english: If you strike someone, the act of striking rests on your own hands — you bear the consequence of violence.
If you curse or abuse another, those very words return to burden your own hands — your speech defines you.

meanings.kannada: ಹಿಂದಣ ಜನನವೇದಡಾಗಲಿ, ಇಂದಿನ ಭೋಗವು ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲೆ
meanings.transliteration: Hindaṇa jananavēdaḍāgali, indina bhōgavu kaiya mēle
meanings.english: Whatever your past birth may have been, the fruits of your present deeds and experiences are entirely in your hands today.

meanings.kannada: ಕೂಡಲಸಂಗಮದೇವಯ್ಯಾ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪೂಜಿಸಿದ ಫಲ ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲೆ
meanings.transliteration: Kūḍala saṅgamadēvayyā, nimma pūjisida phala kaiya mēle
meanings.english: O Lord Kudala Sangama, the reward of worshipping you and living righteously is immediate — it is right here, in our own hands.

contextCards.text: Personal accountability — every action, word, and deed creates its own immediate result in this very life.
Basavanna rejects fatalism. Past births do not bind us — righteous living brings its own fruit, here and now.

akkamahadevi.name: Akkamahadevi
akkamahadevi.subtitle: 12th-century mystic saint and devotional poet. Known for her passionate love poetry and radical spiritual independence.

meanings.english: To the Lord Shuliga, I have offered my body,
I have given my mind as well.
I have devoted my entire being to Him,
O brave and beautiful one, You are my Lord and master.

contextCards.text: Total surrender to the divine beloved. The dissolution of ego through ecstatic devotion.
Akkamahadevi rejects social conventions for authentic spiritual experience. Divine union transcends all worldly attachments.
